title: 對手停在 2♠，單張黑桃的 11 點要不要重開賭倍？
auction_before_decision: P 1S X P 1NT 2H P 2S P P

sampling.method: Fix South's 13 cards, shuffle the other 39 uniformly, reject deals outside the bidding model, stop at 10,000 accepted deals.

scoring.IMP: Per board, NS (Double continuation score minus Pass score) converted to IMP, then averaged
scoring.BAM: Against Pass only: win 1, tie 0.5, loss 0

double_branch: West next; all four seats search legal calls with perfect information (C++ minimax on the DD table, preserving the auction, first bidders and vulnerability). One optimal auction path is saved; contract uniqueness is recorded, path uniqueness is not.

assumptions.protect_32: EW never double an NS three-level suit contract with exactly eight trumps when EW trumps split 3-2
assumptions.protect_32_41: Same, also for a 4-1 split; 5-0, other levels and notrump are not protected
